{{Short description|Polish mathematical physicist (born 1985)}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=February 2022}}
[[File:Schenkel Benini Rejzner Schweigert 2016 MFO21430.jpg|thumb|Alexander Schenkel, Marco Benini, Kasia Rejzner, and {{ill|Christoph Schweigert|de}} at [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] for the 2016 mini-workshop ''New Interactions between Homotopical Algebra and Quantum Field Theory'']]
'''Katarzyna (Kasia) Anna Rejzner''' (born 1985) is a Polish [[mathematical physics|mathematical physicist]] specializing in [[algebraic quantum field theory]] and the theory of [[renormalization]],{{r|wim|quanta}} including the [[Batalin–Vilkovisky formalism]]. She works as a professor in mathematics at the [[University of York]].{{r|cv}}

==Education and career==
Rejzner was born in 1985 in [[Kraków]],{{r|born}} the daughter of two architects.{{r|pi}} She earned a master's degree in physics in 2009 from [[Jagiellonian University]], and completed her Ph.D. in 2011 at the [[University of Hamburg]] under the supervision of [[Klaus Fredenhagen]], with a dissertation on the [[Batalin–Vilkovisky formalism]].{{r|mg}} After postdoctoral studies at the [[University of Rome Tor Vergata]] she joined the University of York in 2013, and was promoted to senior lecturer there in 2017.{{r|cv}} In 2016 and 2017, she visited the [[Perimeter Institute]] as an [[Emmy Noether]] Visiting Fellow.{{r|pi}} She was promoted to the position of full professor in Mathematics, University of York in 2024.{{r|uy}}
During the term 2024-2026, Rejzner serves as the President of the
[[International Association of Mathematical Physics]] (IAMP), being the 
first female in this position since the foundation of the IAMP. {{r|iamp}}
==Book==
Rejzner is the author of the book ''Perturbative Algebraic Quantum Field Theory: An Introduction for Mathematicians'' (Mathematical Physics Studies, Springer, 2016).{{r|paq}}
